label: Start stretch
cue: Back supported by 45 degree bench; both arms hang; palms forward.

label: Begin curl
cue: Flex elbows about 40 degrees, upper arms vertical and fixed.

label: Mid curl
cue: Flex elbows about 80 degrees, wrists neutral.

label: Top curl
cue: Flex elbows about 120 degrees, no upper arm drift.

label: Controlled lowering
cue: Lower to about 80 degrees elbow flexion; reuse frame 3 when equivalent.

label: Return toward stretch
cue: Lower to about 40 degrees; reuse frame 2 when equivalent.
